title: Charge-Based Ability Cooldowns
description: Create an ability cooldown system that supports independent abilities, multiple charges, recharge queues, and cooldown modifiers.
requirements: Abilities must use stable identifiers rather than display names.
Using a charge must begin recharging only the missing charge.
Cooldown progress must be available as a normalised value.
Changing a cooldown modifier must preserve valid progress.
The system must define what happens when an active cooldown is restarted.
constraint: The solution must remain safe when a tracked object is removed unexpectedly.
